chapter: Vernon Andrade's band and Harlem life
title: Vernon Andrade from Panama and his island musicians
summary: Andrade was a quiet, businesslike Panamanian; the band included men from the islands, Zutty and Louie Metcalf.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I mean you must have been very well known in Harlem by this time.
Oh, yeah, definitely. We had all them big jobs, and we -- because we went to the Savoy at that particular time. We had a big contract to see at the -- Andrade was (unintelligible) strictly business.
Well, what sort of a name is that?

Vernon Andrade. Most of them -- the rest of -- the piano player, he was from Panama. They all went to school down in Louisiana, and (unintelligible) went to the little laboratory, to the school there in Atlanta, Georgia. See, most of them fellows come from the islands -- like Spanish, like Panama and Cuba. They come and join the band.
I see. Yeah, well, it just seems to be that that band, that would be able to -- I mean was Zuffy in that band?
Zutty was in there, Al Morgan.
